title: Pricing page brief
description: Brief the pricing page or a price change: plans and limits, how prices compare with alternatives, taxes and terms, and what existing customers see.

inputs.label: Plans, prices, currencies and billing periods approved by finance
Changes for existing customers and their notice period
Competitor and substitute prices with their dates, from the market dossier

tool_actions.description: Notifying existing customers of a price change.

sections.title: Plans and limits
sections.prompt: Each plan, its price, what it includes and its limits.

sections.title: Comparison with alternatives
sections.prompt: How the plans compare with competitors and substitutes, each price with its date and source.

sections.title: Taxes, currency and terms
sections.prompt: Whether prices include tax, the currencies, the billing periods and the link to the terms of sale.

sections.title: Existing customers
sections.prompt: What changes for current customers, when, and how they are told.

sections.title: Questions
sections.prompt: The pricing questions sales and support hear, with their answers.

checks.verification: Finance approved every price, currency and discount shown.
The page matches the terms of sale and the billing system.
Each competitor price used has a source and a date less than 180 days old.
Existing customers affected are told within their contractual notice period.
